originalRequest: i want you to understant the project and my goal  and my prifinceses and go and and rebuild a prototype for it not the full app just the important screens and for refrencese suggest to my some design pattrens and i can rank them for you so you understand what i like and what is not
subject: Eros MemoryOS, a private, iPhone-first personal memory interface for capturing thoughts and connecting them to people, projects, ideas and reminders.
scope: Design an interactive concept prototype of the core product screens. Include a reference comparison stage for learning the owner's visual preferences. This phase defines the brief only.
primaryGoal: Make recording or writing a thought effortless, then show how the owner can find, understand and correct the resulting personal memory.
audience: The owner, using an iPhone 15 Pro Max with Arabic and English content.
offer: A personal memory workspace with simple capture, connected information and owner-defined rules. Everyday use is intended to remain on the phone without a daily Mac or server dependency.
primaryAction: Record a thought with one prominent button, or enter text without first choosing a folder.
creativeControl: Choose a focused screen set and coherent sample journey autonomously. Offer distinct reference-based patterns for the owner to rank in a later preference stage. Keep the visual direction provisional until that feedback is available.
requiredContent: Design direction comparison: present three reference-based interface patterns for later ranking: capture-centered voice notebook, conversational memory workspace, and organized personal library. Compare capture, navigation and information density using the same sample content. These are candidates, not selected styles.
Capture home: prominent recording button, text input, access to attachments and a hidden navigation drawer. Show idle, recording and saved states with minimal steps.
Capture review: show an illustrative transcript, suggested person and project links, tentative actions and correction controls. Clearly distinguish saved input from simulated processing.

Memory search and answer: ask a question about captured information, view an illustrative answer and open its dated source. Include an insufficient-evidence state and separate interpretations from confirmed facts.
People view and profile: browse people and inspect one fictional person's discussions, linked projects, important dates and chosen reminders.
Projects view and detail: browse projects and inspect linked captures, ideas, current plans and tentative future work without treating possibilities as commitments.
Source detail: inspect an original note or conversation alongside extracted information and clearly labeled interpretation; demonstrate correcting a mistaken link.
Reminders and rules: show owner-selected reminders and a simple editable rule example. Calendar actions remain previews rather than live integrations.
Hidden navigation and custom tabs: demonstrate opening and closing the sidebar, switching core views and requesting a named custom tab. Saved-filter behavior is a prototype proposal.
Local control and connections: provide a compact settings view showing local-use intent and optional disconnected services. Explain selected-data sharing without implying that any integration works.
constraints: Briefing only in this turn. Do not create or edit the prototype, assets or application.
Prototype scope excludes production storage, real AI, transcription, account connections, calendar writes, sync and deployment.
Prioritize iPhone 15 Pro Max composition, Arabic RTL, English LTR and mixed-language content.
Keep capture simple, with no mandatory classification questionnaire and no permanently visible sidebar.
Use clearly identified fictional sample memories. Do not import private conversations or invent verified performance claims.
Preserve the distinction between requested capabilities and proposed supporting interactions.
Use selected reference images for desktop and mobile screen composition in later design phases.
Include useful transitions for recording states, tabs, navigation, drawers and filtering. Respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do not select an application framework, model, database or cloud provider through visual design.
brandInputs: README.md and docs/product-overview.md establish the Eros MemoryOS name and personal, phone-first product direction.
docs/product-overview.md and docs/decisions/decision-register.md specify minimal capture, a large recording button, text input, a hidden sidebar and requested custom tabs.
The reviewed project documents establish no approved palette, typography, logo or screen design. Leave those choices open for reference selection.
assumptions: The current request advances the earlier documentation-only direction toward prototype design, but does not authorize building the full application. This turn remains briefing-only.
The project documents report no existing application, so rebuild is interpreted as creating a fresh concept prototype grounded in the documented goals.
A browser-viewable, mobile-first interactive prototype is the intended later artifact; desktop presentation should preserve the phone-first hierarchy.
The core demonstration follows capture, review, retrieval, source inspection and correction. People, projects and reminders supply connected context.
Source-backed answers, capture receipts, correction controls and custom tabs as saved views are proposed prototype interactions, not previously approved implementation decisions.
Use a fictional birthday and tentative website proposal to demonstrate that a possible action is not a confirmed commitment.
Ranking is deferred to the subsequent reference stage. No preference question is required to complete this brief.
This is an operating product interface, so marketing sections and an eight-section landing-page minimum do not apply.
unresolved: Reference images and the owner's ranking remain to be collected in the next design stage.
Colors, typography and icon style remain open until reference selection.
Real device performance, integration permissions and production architecture remain outside this prototype brief.
